newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Strike by 2,000 looms at Avgold - union.
newsitem.headline: Strike by 2,000 looms at Avgold - union.

text.p: A strike by about 2,000 mineworkers is looming at Avgold Ltd's Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines Ltd, the National Union of Mineworkers said in a statement on Wednesday.
"About 2,000 workers are gearing up for a strike at Avgold ETC mines, following the mine management's failure to take satisfactory disciplinary action," the NUM said.

"The matter was not resolved at CCMA (Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration) and therefore the union declared a dispute and will follow all the required legal procedures to prepare for a strike," it said.
Avgold told Reuters that it was aware that a dispute had been declared but had received no notice from the NUM of a pending strike.
The union is demanding that an Agnes shaft hostel manager be dismissed.
